name: China (mainland)
note: A medical institution (or, for unnatural deaths it handles, the police) issues the death certificate, which funeral homes require before collecting and cremating the body. Relatives must declare the death to the hukou registration authority, a public security organ, which cancels the hukou: before burial in cities, within a month in rural areas. The police must in turn tell social insurance agencies, and since the 2025 Funeral Regulations (in force 30 March 2026) death certificate data must be shared through government service platforms. The Civil Code leaves private parties to learn of the death through heirs and the estate administrator.

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国户口登记条例 (Hukou Registration Regulations, 1958), art. 8
citations.title: Death registration and cancellation of hukou
citations.quote: 公民死亡，城市在葬前，农村在一个月以内，由户主、亲属、抚养人或者邻居向户口登记机关申报死亡登记，注销户口。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国户口登记条例, art. 8 (second sentence)
citations.title: Death at a temporary residence
citations.quote: 公民如果在暂住地死亡，由暂住地户口登记机关通知常住地户口登记机关注销户口。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国户口登记条例, art. 3
citations.title: Hukou registration administered by public security organs
citations.quote: 户口登记工作，由各级公安机关主管。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国户口登记条例, art. 4
citations.title: Hukou register books
citations.quote: 户口登记机关应当设立户口登记簿。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国户口登记条例, art. 20
citations.title: Penalties for failing to declare
citations.quote: 有下列情形之一的，根据情节轻重，依法给予治安管理处罚或者追究刑事责任：一、不按照本条例的规定申报户口的；

citations.cite: 殡葬管理条例 (Funeral Administration Regulations, State Council Order No. 824, 2025 revision, in force 30 March 2026), art. 23
citations.title: Death certificates by medical institutions or police; shared through government service platforms
citations.quote: 自然人正常死亡的，医疗卫生机构应当及时出具死亡证明，依托各地政务服务平台共享死亡证明信息。

citations.title: Police certify unnatural deaths they handle
citations.quote: 涉及公安机关依法处置且未经医疗卫生机构救治的非正常死亡案（事）件的逝者，由公安机关出具死亡证明。

citations.title: Funeral home collects body on the death certificate; reports discrepancies to police
citations.quote: 发现遗体状况与死亡证明所载死因明显不符的，应当立即向公安机关报告。

citations.title: Cremation only on a death certificate
citations.quote: 殡仪馆应当凭死亡证明和火化确认书火化遗体，并出具火化证明。

citations.title: Special cases (unidentified, unclaimed, sudden deaths)
citations.quote: 身份不明、无人认领、交通事故中当场死亡以及因其他突发事件死亡等特殊情形的死亡证明出具、遗体处置的办法，由国务院民政部门会同国务院公安部门、卫生健康部门等制定。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国社会保险法 (Social Insurance Law, 2018 amendment), art. 57(3)
citations.title: Police notify social insurance agencies of deaths
citations.quote: 公安机关应当及时向社会保险经办机构通报个人的出生、死亡以及户口登记、迁移、注销等情况。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国社会保险法, art. 14
citations.title: Individual pension account balance inheritable
citations.quote: 个人死亡的，个人账户余额可以继承。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国民法典 (Civil Code), art. 1121
citations.title: Succession opens at death
citations.quote: 继承从被继承人死亡时开始。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国民法典, art. 1150
citations.title: Duty to notify other heirs; work unit or residents' committee notifies if no heir can
citations.quote: 继承人中无人知道被继承人死亡或者知道被继承人死亡而不能通知的，由被继承人生前所在单位或者住所地的居民委员会、村民委员会负责通知。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国民法典, art. 1145
citations.title: Estate administrator; civil affairs department where there are no heirs
citations.quote: 没有继承人或者继承人均放弃继承的，由被继承人生前住所地的民政部门或者村民委员会担任遗产管理人。

citations.cite: 中华人民共和国民法典, art. 1147
citations.title: Estate administrator's duties include settling debts and claims
citations.quote: （四）处理被继承人的债权债务；

citations.cite: 国家卫生计生委、公安部、民政部《关于进一步规范人口死亡医学证明和信息登记管理工作的通知》(国卫规划发〔2013〕57号)
citations.title: Medical certificate of death (居民死亡医学证明（推断）书) and death information registration

citations.cite: 国家卫生健康委办公厅《关于进一步加强医学证明文件类医疗文书管理工作的通知》(国卫办医政函〔2024〕8号), item 5
citations.title: Medical certificate documents; the death certificate form is governed by its own national rules
citations.quote: 出生医学证明书、居民死亡医学证明（推断）书、职业病诊断证明书等已有明确规定的医疗文书，严格按照国家有关规定进行管理。

steps.title: Medical institution issues the death certificate
steps.localName: 居民死亡医学证明（推断）书
steps.who: The medical or health institution (hospital, or the community/township health centre for deaths at home).
steps.summary: For a normal death the medical institution must promptly issue the death certificate — in practice the national 居民死亡医学证明（推断）书 form, which also records the cause of death.

steps.title: Cause of death recorded on the national medical certificate form
steps.who: The certifying doctor at the medical institution.
steps.summary: The cause of death is recorded on the national form, the 居民死亡医学证明（推断）书, which the National Health Commission treats as a medical document already governed by specific national rules that institutions must follow strictly. Those rules (the 2013 NHFPC/MPS/MCA notice) could not be read from an official host, so the form's parts and who receives each copy are not recorded here.

steps.title: Police certify unnatural deaths they handle
steps.trigger: An unnatural death handled by the police without treatment at a medical institution.
steps.summary: For unnatural deaths dealt with by the police and not treated in a medical institution, the police issue the death certificate. Rules for unidentified, unclaimed and sudden deaths are left to joint ministry measures.

steps.title: Funeral home reports a body that does not match the stated cause
steps.trigger: Collecting a body whose condition clearly differs from the cause on the death certificate.
steps.summary: The funeral home collects bodies only on a death certificate and must immediately report to the police if the body's condition clearly conflicts with the certified cause.

steps.title: Declare the death to the hukou registration authority and cancel the hukou
steps.who: The head of household, relatives, carers or neighbours, to the hukou registration authority (local public security police station).

deadline.text: in cities before burial; in rural areas within one month

steps.summary: The death must be declared to the hukou registration authority (a public security organ) and the hukou cancelled: in cities before burial, in rural areas within a month. Failure to declare can attract a public-security administrative penalty.

steps.title: Temporary-residence police tell the permanent-residence hukou office
steps.who: The hukou authority where the deceased temporarily resided.
steps.trigger: Death at a place of temporary residence.
steps.summary: Where a person dies at a temporary residence, that hukou office notifies the office of permanent residence to cancel the hukou.

steps.title: Funeral home cremates only on the death certificate
steps.who: The family (丧属) presents the death certificate and cremation confirmation.
steps.summary: Cremation requires the death certificate (not proof of hukou cancellation) and a cremation confirmation; the funeral home then issues a cremation certificate, which cemeteries and columbaria require.

steps.title: Hukou cancelled; family holds the medical certificate and cremation certificate
steps.summary: The regulations provide for cancellation of the hukou in the register but do not set up a separate civil death certificate or say who may obtain records; the family relies on the medical certificate, the hukou cancellation record and the cremation certificate.

steps.title: Death certificate information shared through government service platforms
steps.who: Medical institutions, via provincial/local government service (政务服务) platforms.
steps.latencyNote: 应当及时出具死亡证明，依托各地政务服务平台共享 (binzang-23)
steps.summary: From 30 March 2026 medical institutions must share death certificate information through local government service platforms, the first national-level rule for electronic propagation of the medical death record.

steps.title: Police notify social insurance agencies of deaths
steps.latencyNote: 公安机关应当及时向社会保险经办机构通报个人的…死亡 (socins-57)
steps.summary: The Social Insurance Law requires the police to inform social insurance agencies promptly of births, deaths and hukou cancellations, so pensions and insurance can stop; the individual pension account balance is inheritable.

steps.title: Death information registered for cause-of-death statistics
steps.who: Medical institutions, into the health system's death information registration (CDC cause-of-death reporting).
steps.summary: Under the 2013 notice and the 2014 death-information registration norms, certifying institutions register each death online for national cause-of-death surveillance. Not read from an official host.

steps.title: Heirs notify each other; work unit or residents' committee steps in
steps.who: An heir who knows of the death; failing that, the deceased's work unit (employer) or residents'/villagers' committee.
steps.summary: The Civil Code obliges heirs who know of the death to notify the other heirs and the executor; if none can, the deceased's work unit or residents' or villagers' committee must notify them.

steps.title: Estate administrator settles claims and debts
steps.who: The executor, or heirs as estate administrator; the civil-affairs department or villagers' committee where there are no heirs.
steps.summary: The estate administrator inventories the estate and deals with the deceased's claims and debts; banks and other creditors and debtors learn of the death this way. No official death-data service for banks or insurers was found.

registrationDeadlineDays.note: Rural areas: within one month; cities: before burial (no fixed number of days).

informantDuty.note: Head of household, relatives, carers or neighbours.

medicalExaminerScrutiny.note: No independent review of certificates; the funeral home must report mismatches to the police.

electronicRegistration.note: Hukou death declaration is made to the police station; since 2026 medical institutions must share death certificate data via government service platforms.

centralPopulationRegister.name: 户口 (hukou) registration kept by public security organs
centralPopulationRegister.note: The hukou register is the population register; national integration of the hukou database is not set out in the 1958 regulations.

governmentPropagation.note: Police must notify social insurance agencies of deaths; death certificate data is shared through government service platforms. Coverage of other bodies (tax, health insurance) not established.

certificateAccess.note: The 1958 regulations do not provide for a civil death certificate or say who may obtain hukou cancellation records.

privateSectorVerification.note: No official route for banks or insurers to verify deaths was found; they rely on documents presented by heirs or the estate administrator.

gaps: The 2013 NHFPC/MPS/MCA notice (国卫规划发〔2013〕57号) on the 居民死亡医学证明（推断）书 and the 2014 death-information registration norms could not be read: www.nhc.gov.cn, www.mca.gov.cn, www.mps.gov.cn and the local-government reprints (www.lushixian.gov.cn and others) are egress-denied, and neither the gov.cn policy library search nor flk.npc.gov.cn carries the notice (flk's full-text search returned unrelated laws, so its filter is not trusted). The 2024 NHC notice on gov.cn confirms only that the form is governed by its own national rules. The statistics step (death information registration for cause-of-death surveillance) stays unverified, with no latency.
A 2026 national notice (reported as 国卫规划发〔2026〕5号) on electronic death certificates was seen only in a search snippet and not read.
Who may obtain hukou cancellation proof or a death record was not established; certificateAccess left null.
No statute found tying death registration to tax, medical insurance (医保), ID card cancellation (居民身份证法 has no death provision), or passports.
No official death-verification service for banks/insurers found. Provincial rules (e.g. on home-death certification by community health centres) were not reviewed.
